title: Monsters and Weapons
description:
Monsters and WeaponsA strategic rogue-like based on decision making. Fight your way through different areas, buy items and defeat the final boss to proclaim victory!

• Highly strategic.

• Unique "semi" turn-based fights where you control the pace.

• Ten unlockable and unique classes.

• Achievements (hard).

• Impactful decisions with a smidge of luck.

• Unlock Legendary Mode for the ultimate challenge!

• Inventory management.

• Boss fights.

• Many items and creative item combinations.
description_short: Monsters and Weapons is a strategic rogue-like game based on decision making. You fight your way through 3 areas as one of ten different classes. Slay monsters, buy items in shops and spend your resources wisely. In Monsters and Weapons every decision counts!
